wiki.title: Denise Tepler
wiki.extract: Denise Anne Tepler (born May 15, 1956) is an American politician serving as a member of the Maine Senate from the 24th district. A Democrat, she was first elected to the Maine House of Representatives in November 2014, she assumed office on December 3, 2014, before being term-limited in 2022 and choosing to run for the Senate in 2024.
